Then it loads the actor object from [RCX] (RCX = a pointer to the context object = this) and tail-jumps through its vtable at byte offset 0x630 (vtable slot 0x630/8 = 0x18c). So the UFUNCTION's entire exec is a virtual dispatch to the class's virtual method at vtable+0x630.
